history_notes: Formed by amalgamation of Ahascragh and Fohenagh; official club history says juvenile amalgamation in 1999 and full adult amalgamation in 2002.
The official history says the club won its first adult title since 1999 in the 2009-10 Galway Junior C championship.

Historic predecessor club Fohenagh won Galway Senior Hurling Championship titles in 1959 and 1960 (vs Castlegar); these are not Ahascragh-Fohenagh amalgam titles. See historic_predecessor and data/historic-fohenagh-1959-1960.json.

research_notes.archive_status: INA Search UI was used successfully while logged in; query Ahascragh-Fohenagh returned 1,566 results and Fohenagh returned 9,179 results. OCR was extracted from promising scans; no password was entered.
research_notes.method: INA OCR excerpts and public sources were used. Scores are included only when clearly printed; unclear OCR is explicitly marked.

historic_1959_1960.archive_status: INA searched while logged in with 1959–1961 date filter; contemporary 1959 draw/replay and 1960 final reports captured; no password entered.
historic_1959_1960.method: INA OCR and page scans plus public Galway GAA, HoganStand, Wikipedia, local histories and NLI catalogue; contemporary INA reports resolve the 1959 draw/replay and confirm the 1960 final.
historic_1959_1960.score_resolution: 1959 resolved from contemporary INA: draw Fohenagh 2-8 Castlegar 1-11 (Pearse Stadium); replay Fohenagh 3-9 Castlegar 4-5 (Kenny Memorial Park, Athenry). Also Irish Independent 31 Aug 1959 prints draw score.
